posts.title: Vibe Coding Is Not Software Engineering
posts.description: Vibe coding writes the code. Engineering is the pipeline around it and the judgement to know what’s right, and fewer juniors are being hired to learn it.

posts.title: Why Would You Ever Choose Node?
posts.description: Our Node services get hammered with vulnerabilities daily and .NET is fine. npm takes eleven advisories a day to NuGet’s one. Use Node when you must.

posts.title: Cutting the Wrong Layer
posts.description: Meta planned to hand thousands of staff’s work to AI. Developers are the wrong layer to cut. AI is best at summarising, a lot of what middle managers do.
